name: How long does a bathroom shower installation usually take?
description: Simple replacements can take a few days. Conversions and custom showers take longer, especially if plumbing or materials delay the job.

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom shower installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a simple shower replacement, the work may take a few days. Tub-to-shower conversions and more customized installations often take longer, especially if materials are backordered or plumbing needs to be changed.
